interface optional & readonly members.description:
TS 1.0 (readonly member: TS 2.0)
interface member modifiers
`readonly` prevents reassignment after initialization; `?` marks a property optional. Both are structural, compile-time only.

interface method signature.description:

interface method signature
Declares a method's shape without an implementation.

callable (hybrid) interface.description:
TS 1.0
callable (hybrid) interface
Describes a value that can itself be called as a function while also carrying properties — common for typing callable objects/functions-with-statics.
